final: WITH j AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, e.`aCL IgG` AS igg, e.ANA AS ana FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID), g AS (SELECT sex, AVG(igg) AS avg_igg, AVG(ana) AS a FROM j GROUP BY sex), b AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS b_val FROM g WHERE a IS NOT NULL) SELECT g.sex, g.avg_igg, g.a, g.a * 1.0 / b.b_val AS ratio FROM g JOIN b ON b.b_val IS NOT NULL ORDER BY g.sex
